lines: Last stop. No trolleys, no buttons, no guns. Just you, me, and this.

lines.text: You thought I was making it up as I went. I was. I was also writing it all down.

lines: Every choice. Every hesitation. Every time you hovered. I have it here, in very small handwriting.

beats.title: The Notebook
ask: Let us start with the strange ones. The choices hardly anybody made.

notebook: That is either character or bad luck. I have stopped being able to tell.

notebook.text: And the car, of course. We will not talk about the car.

beats.title: Your Portrait
ask: Now. Hold still. This is you.

one_many_first: The [amber]one[/amber] over the [amber]many[/amber], again and again. You kept seeing a face where the rest saw a number. Very human. Terrible at arithmetic.
one_many_second: The [amber]many[/amber], every time. [amber]Five[/amber] beats [amber]one[/amber]. Lovely maths. Terrible dinner guest.
one_many_middle: The one or the many, you could never settle. You counted every time, and hated the answer every time.
mercy_justice_first: For a judge, you let a lot of people off. A late conversion, or the robe was hiding it all along.

mercy_justice_second.text: Still a judge. Death did not take it out of you. Nothing will.

mercy_justice_middle: Mercy some days, justice others. Depending, I suspect, on lunch.
ends_rules_first: The rules were suggestions. The outcome was the point. Whatever it took.
ends_rules_second: You kept the rules. Even mine. Even the stupid ones. Especially the stupid ones.
ends_rules_middle: Rules when they suited you, ends when they did not. Most people call that common sense. I call it a lawyer.
order_freedom_first: You like things in rows. Forms filled in. A queue that moves.
order_freedom_second: You do not like being told. I told you all game. It must have been agony.
order_freedom_middle: Order or freedom. You never picked. You waited to see which one the room liked.
self_others_first: You put yourself at the centre. Everybody does. You just did not bother to hide it.
self_others_second: You kept putting other people first. Exhausting to watch. Exhausting to be, I imagine.
self_others_middle: You and them, half and half. Like a sandwich nobody ordered.
risk_safety_first: You pressed. You bid. You spun. You never once left a button alone.
risk_safety_second: You kept the money, lowered the gun and backed away from every edge. Nobody has ever had a safer time being [red]dead[/red].
risk_safety_middle: Some risks, some safety. A gambler who reads the small print.

beats.title: The Lever, Again
ask: One more. The first real one, again. Same five. Same one. Same lever.
Everything you have been through since. Let us see if any of it got in.

reaction.text: You pulled then. You pull now. Nothing I did touched you. I am almost impressed.
You would not touch it at the start. Now you pull. I broke something in you. Or fixed it. I never know which.
You left it then. You leave it now. Hands clean, both times. Same man, start to finish.
You pulled at the start. Now you will not. Something got in. I would love to know what. No I would not.

reveal.heading: how others chose, the second time

beats.title: The Posting
ask: Now. Where to put you. Everybody here becomes something. The void does not waste a soul.

ask.text: I have looked at the way you leaned, and I know exactly what you are for.

lever: A lever. You will stand at a fork forever, and every so often someone will pull you. You will love it.
plea: The words on the tracks. Please, not me. You will be said by strangers at their worst moment. You will be very moving.
curtain: The curtain in the booth. You will hang there, tied back, hiding people while they confess. You will hear everything and tell no one.
gavel: The gavel. Nobody ever sees it. Everybody hears it. You will be banged on a desk for eternity, and you will find it very satisfying.
trolley: The trolley. You go where you are sent, and you never look back at what you hit.
rails: The rails. Everything runs along you, and nothing ever asks you anything. Bliss.
clerk: My clerk. Forms, dockets, queues in rows. You will be happier [red]dead[/red] than you ever were alive.
button: A button. Pressed by strangers, day and night. And one day, if you are very lucky, you will get up and walk away. It has happened. Once.
die: The die. Everyone blows on you for luck. You will think it is all about you. It is.
crowd: The crowd. One grey bar among the many. Every time anyone asks how others chose, they will be asking about you.
pin: The pin. Spun round and round over the map and dropped wherever. You will adore it.
paper: The paper. Everything is drawn on you, and nothing ever happens to you.
imp: You leaned on nothing. Even, careful, impossible to read. Perfect. You will take my job.

imp.text: Every one of them gets a little game. Be cruel. Be fair. Be whatever you like. It is your call.
